reviewItem.question: Does "loki Results Cache: Adds `query_length_served` cache stat to measure the length of the query served from cache" mean a change to config-key:loki|path=query_length_served|component=results-cache (added)?

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds a new cache statistic `query_length_served` to the Results Cache to measure the length of query results served from cache.
